summary.tpReason: Telemetry confirms a real, allowed DNS A-record lookup for avsvmcloud.com at the alert timestamp from 17.81.146.1. The domain is the documented SUNBURST/SolarWinds C2 domain, so detection of the malicious indicator is credible. No evidence shows the lookup was benign or a rule artifact.
summary.fpReason: Only one DNS event is present, with identity recorded generically as HOSTNAME and no endpoint, process, or connection telemetry. CISA cautions that resolving avsvmcloud.com alone does not prove the SolarWinds backdoor was used.
summary.whatHappened: At 2020-03-19 22:33:58.219 UTC, Umbrella DNS telemetry recorded one A-record query for avsvmcloud.com from internal IP 17.81.146.1, associated with generic identity HOSTNAME. The request was Allowed and returned NOERROR; 15.230.137.45 is recorded as the related external IP. No additional avsvmcloud queries or matching CommonSecurityLog, CrowdStrike, or Windows SecurityEvent corroboration were found. This establishes suspicious DNS resolution, not confirmed malware execution, C2 success, or host compromise.
keyEvidence: solarigate_beacon_umbrella_CL: exactly one event at 2020-03-19 22:33:58.219Z; avsvmcloud.com, InternalIp 17.81.146.1, ExternalIp 15.230.137.45, Allowed, NOERROR, A record, identity HOSTNAME.
SecurityAlert d52663c4-9e5d-c225-9489-780322169846 matches the same timestamp and event; severity High; compromised entity 17.81.146.1.
The solarigate table contains only one total record; no matching CommonSecurityLog, CrowdStrikeDetections, CrowdStrikeHosts, or SecurityEvent records were returned.

CISA AA20-352A (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa20-352a) identifies avsvmcloud.com as a SUNBURST check-in/C2 domain but states that observing traffic alone does not prove backdoor use.

CISA remediation guidance (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/news/remediating-networks-affected-solarwinds-and-active-directorym365-compromise) distinguishes more serious compromise through follow-on/secondary C2 activity.
summary.nextAction: Map 17.81.146.1 to its hostname and DNS client, and restrict/isolate it pending triage. Review endpoint, DNS, proxy, and firewall logs around and after 22:33:58 UTC for the querying process, CNAME/secondary domains, and connections to 15.230.137.45. Check affected SolarWinds versions and SUNBURST artifacts, then hunt identity/cloud logs for follow-on activity. Do not claim compromise from this lookup alone.
